title: Five-day kindness challenge
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 2: Hadith, akhlaq and Important Lessons
source: Written for islamic-studies/y8 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: five-day kindness challenge)
intro: Lesson 21: Living the akhlaq: kindness and gentleness. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Muslim, from Aishah
paras: Gentleness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is not removed from anything except that it disgraces it.

panels.title: Kindness in the Sunnah
points: A man was forgiven for giving water to a thirsty dog
Removing harm from the road is charity

keywords.def: doing good beautifully, to people and animals

questions.q: Explain what the hadith on gentleness teaches.
questions.a: Gentleness makes everything better; harshness spoils things, even good things.

questions.q: Removing harm from the road is ...

Kindness challenge plan on the pupil PDF: one act of kindness a day for five days (family, neighbour, classmate online, animal, stranger), each with the Sunnah link. Then a short reflection in the portal response box on which will be hardest and why.
questions.a: Five realistic acts with Sunnah links; honest reflection

questions.q: Extend: how can you correct a friend gently?
questions.a: Privately, calmly, with a reason, and kind words.

questions.q: Stretch: why does gentleness help da'wah?
questions.a: People listen to gentle words; Allah told Musa to speak gently even to Pharaoh (20:44).

questions.q: Why was a man forgiven in the hadith?
options: He gave water to a thirsty dog
questions.a: A) He gave water to a thirsty dog. Bukhari and Muslim: mercy to an animal was rewarded.

questions.q: Think again: is kindness weakness or strength?
questions.a: Strength: it takes self-control and pleases Allah.
